The command-line runtime used by the AI NPC Skills.

## Install

```bash
npm install --global ai-npc-planner@0.1.0
```

The package provides the `npcctl` command. It requires Node.js 18.19.1 or newer and currently stores credentials in the macOS Keychain.

Run `npcctl auth login --env dev` only when a command reports `auth_required`.
